summary: Tested requested backend+frontend changes for 5-tab navigation, simplified dashboard, Menu screen routes, and backup export flow. Backend regression passed; frontend mobile flow partially passed with one automation blocker after Detail Pengguna navigation.

integration_issues.issue: Public preview intermittently showed 'The preview environment is not responding' (ngrok tunnel instability) after Expo restart, causing first two UI attempts to fail before app render.

Run stopped after 3 attempts per loop-prevention. Third attempt reached Detail Pengguna screen, but subsequent wait step timed out due brittle text-based assertion/duplicate text context; remaining submenu paths were not fully re-validated in same run.

action_items: Main agent should add explicit page-root testIDs for users/workshop/settings/about/backup screens to make route assertions stable without duplicate text ambiguity.
Main agent should add testID for ScreenShell back button for deterministic Menu->screen->back testing.
Main agent should investigate Expo tunnel/ngrok instability seen in logs; app itself works when tunnel is healthy.
Align frontend env key usage with policy: support EXPO_BACKEND_URL directly in frontend/lib/api.ts (currently EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL path is used).
Align backend fail-fast env policy by removing fallback defaults for DB_NAME and JWT_SECRET in backend/server.py.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py still has fallback defaults for DB_NAME and JWT_SECRET, which conflicts with env-only fail-fast guideline.
frontend/lib/api.ts does not read EXPO_BACKEND_URL directly; it relies on expo extra + EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
Before this run, tab/menu/backup interactions lacked stable testIDs; added for better mobile E2E reliability.

success_rate.frontend: 70% (core tab count/dashboard/menu open validated; full submenu traversal blocked by automation stability issue)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created in this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on third run: login successful, dashboard loaded, tab count=5, Menu tab centered, dashboard sections present, and old dashboard menu card text absent. Automation then stopped at Menu traversal assertion after Detail Pengguna screen was already visible (screenshot confirms route). Continue from Menu screen with page-root testIDs to complete deterministic verification.
rca_of_issue: Primary blocker was environment/tunnel instability: Expo logs repeatedly showed ngrok tunnel connection failures, causing preview placeholder page and login selector timeouts in first two attempts. In third attempt app loaded and key checks passed, but remaining route validation failed due assertion brittleness in duplicate text context rather than confirmed functional crash.
